script.description: Complete source script with dialogue, speaker labels, scenes and non-dialogue cues. Keep its story and non-dialogue facts while refining spoken lines.

output_count.description: Exact number of dialogue-refined script variations to return. Defaults to 3.

scene_duration_seconds.description: Maximum duration per scene in seconds, including speech and existing non-dialogue beats. Defaults to 10.0.

scene_count.description: Target number of scenes per variation, not a hard maximum. Additional scenes are allowed when coherent dialogue cannot fit the timing target. Defaults to 1.

min.description: Minimum words per second for spoken dialogue.

max.description: Maximum words per second for spoken dialogue.

wps_range.description: Allowed speaking pace in words per second for timing dialogue. Defaults to 2.5–3.5 WPS.

issues_found.description: Optional dialogue-related issues supplied by the caller; omission does not disable automatic diagnosis.

correction_focus.description: Optional dialogue priorities; omission does not disable other dialogue checks.

examples.script:
INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT
MAYA holds an unopened letter.
MAYA
The letter came today.
ARUN
We should leave before dawn.
MAYA
No. I am afraid of what it says.

INT. NEWSROOM - NIGHT
ANCHOR looks into camera.
ANCHOR
Emergency talks in three countries ended without agreement after hours of debate. Leaders will meet again tomorrow.

issues_found.description: Two sentences plus the opening camera beat exceed the available scene time.
